source_name: Ziraat Bank Kosova — corporate site
source_subtype: bank corporate website (no report archive found)
why_relevant: Smallest-tier licensed bank in the cell; site documents branch footprint (Pristina, Prizren, Peja, Ferizaj) and mobile-banking product, but no annual-report section surfaced. Worth tracking as the low-end anchor of network scale and as a check on whether small banks disclose at all.

source_name: ProCredit Holding AG group annual report (Kosovo segment)
why_relevant: Frankfurt-listed parent must report segment data; the Kosovo subsidiary appears as a reportable segment with customer, loan and channel metrics, giving a regulated-quality cross-check on the local report and often earlier publication.

source_name: NLB Group (Ljubljana) — reports covering NLB Banka Prishtina
why_relevant: NLB d.d. is LJSE/Frankfurt-listed and reports per-market segment results including Kosovo, plus a market page for the Prishtina subsidiary; group disclosure is timelier and more standardised than the local annual report.

source_name: Türk Ekonomi Bankası (TEB) / BNP Paribas group annual reports
why_relevant: TEB Sh.A. Kosovo is owned via the TEB Group (BNP Paribas + Türk Ekonomi Bankası); the Turkish parent's annual reports describe the Kosovo subsidiary and provide a second, independently-audited statement of its scale.

source_name: BKT Albania (parent) — consolidated periodic financial reporting incl. Kosovo
why_relevant: BKT Albania's consolidated periodic reports explicitly consolidate 'the Bank, its branch in Kosovo, and BKT Pay', and are published quarterly — a higher-frequency read on the BKT Kosovo perimeter than the Kosovo entity's annual report, and reachable when bkt-ks.com blocks our fetcher.

source_name: Deposit Insurance Fund of Kosovo (FSDK) — member bank list
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of licensed deposit-taking banks, i.e. the definitive actor list this cell must enumerate; changes here flag entries/exits (e.g. the İş Bankası Kosovo branch absorption) before annual reports catch up.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of banks in Kosovo / Banking in Kosovo
why_relevant: Cheap seed list of licensed banks with official domains, useful only to bootstrap crawler targets; every figure must be re-sourced from the bank's own disclosure.

source_name: EMIS company profiles — Kosovo banks (ProCredit, TEB, etc.)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator holding filed financials and company data for Kosovo banks; a paywalled fallback when a bank's own PDF archive is incomplete or a legacy year is missing.

source_name: The Banker Database — TEB Bank Kosovo (and peer) reports
why_relevant: Normalised, comparable balance-sheet series per Kosovo bank, useful for ranking network/asset scale consistently across institutions whose own reports use different formats.

source_name: Yumpu-hosted historic Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo annual reports
why_relevant: Third-party mirror of older RBKO annual reports; a fallback for pre-2010 or delisted years that the bank's own archive no longer serves.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International AG — Investor Relations: Results & Reports (annual/semi-annual/quarterly)
why_relevant: Central hub for RBI group filings that contain a Kosovo country line inside the Southeastern Europe segment; the entry point for annual reports, interim reports, Pillar 3 and presentations that carry Kosovo-level P&L, business volumes, customer and digital-channel figures not published locally.

source_name: RBI Semi-Annual / Quarterly Financial Report — country analysis incl. Kosovo
why_relevant: Search snippet indicates an explicit Kosovo column in the segment/country analysis (net interest income, net fee and commission income, operating result), giving semi-annual Kosovo market data with fee income as a proxy for payments/card activity.

source_name: RBI Regulatory Disclosures / Pillar 3 (CRR Part 8, CRD Art. 89 country-by-country)
why_relevant: CRD Art. 89 CBCR obliges per-country disclosure of turnover, staff numbers, profit before tax and tax for every country of establishment, including third countries such as Kosovo — a legally mandated, comparable annual Kosovo data point on the largest foreign banking group in the market.

source_name: ProCredit Holding AG — Annual Report (group), Kosovo subsidiary key-figures table
why_relevant: Frankfurt-listed parent publishes a per-country key-figures table (loan portfolio, portfolio growth, defaulted-loan share, staff) with an explicit Kosovo row, plus group commentary on digital/direct banking rollout in Kosovo.

source_name: ProCredit Holding — Investor Relations / publications hub
why_relevant: Entry point for quarterly reports, capital-markets presentations and ad-hoc releases of the German-listed parent; these carry per-country segment tables and strategy commentary covering Kosovo between annual reports.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovo — Annual reports archive (group-aligned subsidiary reporting)
why_relevant: Local subsidiary reports in the group template, useful for reconciling group-level Kosovo figures and for channel/digital-banking narrative (ProCredit runs a self-service 24/7 zone model, so ATM/self-service counts appear here).

source_name: NLB Group — Investor Relations (nlbgroup.com)
why_relevant: Ljubljana/London-listed parent; IR hub indexes quarterly results presentations and interim reports that state NLB Banka Prishtina market share, client numbers and digital-channel penetration for Kosovo.

source_name: NLB Group quarterly results presentations (nlb.si financial-reports PDF tree)
why_relevant: Results decks carry per-market slides with Kosovo market share (loans/deposits), client counts and digital-channel adoption metrics — the closest thing to a published Kosovo digital-payments KPI series from a private issuer.

source_name: SEOnet — Ljubljana Stock Exchange regulated-information portal (NLB d.d. issuer filings)
why_relevant: Statutory disclosure channel where NLB's annual and interim reports are filed first; provides authoritative, dated, archived copies (an NLB Annual Report attachment was returned directly from seonet.ljse.si), useful when the corporate site reorganises links.

source_name: NLB Banka Prishtina — Annual reports (subsidiary, group template)
why_relevant: Kosovo subsidiary's own group-styled annual reports; contain channel and card-business narrative plus audited statements that let group-level Kosovo claims be validated.

source_name: KAP — Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu (Turkish Public Disclosure Platform), issuer filings for TEB and Ziraat
why_relevant: Statutory Turkish disclosure platform where TEB A.Ş. and Ziraat Bankası file financial statements and activity reports quarterly; the authoritative, archived route to parent filings that mention Kosova operations, independent of corporate websites.

source_name: Ziraat Bankası — Entegre Faaliyet Raporu (integrated annual report), international/Kosovo branch network sections
why_relevant: Ziraat operates in Kosovo via a country management office and branches (Prishtinë, Prizren, Pejë, Ferizaj); the integrated report's international-network chapter is the main public account of that presence and its branch/service footprint.

source_name: Ziraat Bank Kosova — local site (ziraatbank-kosova.com)
why_relevant: Local presence site of the Turkish state bank's Kosovo operation; branch/ATM locator and product pages give network footprint and card/terminal product signals for a bank that publishes little locally.

source_name: BKT Kosova — Raportet (annual and financial reports of the Albanian parent's Kosovo bank)
why_relevant: BKT Kosova is 100% owned by Banka Kombëtare Tregtare (Albania, Çalık Holding); its Albanian-language report archive is the primary disclosure of client numbers (300k+), 25-branch network, and card/digital product performance.

source_name: Banka Kombëtare Tregtare (Albania) — corporate/IR pages incl. shareholders and group reporting
why_relevant: Parent bank of BKT Kosova; its consolidated reporting and governance disclosures identify the ownership chain (Çalık Holding) and occasionally consolidate Kosovo business volumes — needed to interpret Kosovo subsidiary numbers.

source_name: Çalık Holding — Finance sector / BKT Kosova company page
why_relevant: Ultimate owner's portfolio page provides refreshed headline figures on BKT Kosova (branch count, client base, positioning) and confirms the ownership chain used for group-level attribution.

source_name: financialreports.eu — NLB issuer filings aggregator
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator of European issuer filings; useful as a redundancy/monitoring layer to detect new NLB (and potentially RBI/ProCredit) reports without polling each IR site.
